entity_noun: certification, accreditation, registration, standard, or compliance
evidence_source: the record's focal form and synthesis

sections.heading: Each {{entity_noun}} you identify qualifies only if ALL of these conditions hold for it:

rules.text: The record evidences the {{entity_noun}} you identified — it is named, described, or clearly implied by the record's focal form and synthesis, not merely suggested by a resemblance between words.

children.text: Whose {{entity_noun}} it is has no bearing here. A candidate evidenced by a customer's, supplier's, or any other third party's dealings is still identified and recorded.

The {{entity_noun}} must be identifiable by its own name, number, or issuing body from the record. Meeting a customer's or an industry's specifications, or operating quality assurance systems, is not itself a nameable {{entity_noun}} — never substitute a named standard the record does not name. A statement of commitment, values, or goals, or general praise of quality, reliability, or standing, names nothing that could specifically be held, met, or followed, and identifies no {{entity_noun}}.

rules.text: The {{entity_noun}} you identified is of the kind {{entity_noun}} names, judged against what {{entity_noun}} means. A commitment, value, or goal, a quality practice, general praise of standing, or anything else outside that meaning does not qualify, however clearly the record evidences it.

Neither the provided options nor the record's already-identified results cover the {{entity_noun}} you identified: no option matches it exactly or under different words, judged against {{option_evidence}}, and it does not restate an already-identified result.
